slides.title: Hunger is rising behind the headlines

slides.body: Crisis-level food insecurity expected through January 2027 in parts of South & East Tigray, the Tekeze lowlands, and East & West Hararghe

slides.title: Why?
slides.body: Fighting that escalated from Sept 23 has disrupted fuel, markets and transport. The harvest is below average, and Tigray's green harvest is delayed at least a month.
estimated crop losses in the worst-hit parts of East & West Hararghe, where rains were half of normal or less
rise in sorghum prices in Sekota (Amhara) this August compared with a year earlier

slides.title: Aid is being disrupted
slides.body: Assistance resumed in Tigray this year for 1.1 million+ people, most of them displaced. Renewed fighting is now disrupting distributions.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep roads and markets open. Allow safe humanitarian access.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard, reporting FEWS NET's Sept 2026–Jan 2027 Ethiopia update · Oct 9, 2026

card.title: Hunger is rising behind the headlines
card.body: Crisis-level food insecurity is expected through Jan 2027 in parts of Tigray and East & West Hararghe.
